guard: on a real terminal, --no-input stops meshes add from opening its guided form
why: Only a real terminal reaches a prompt, so only the pty suite can show --no-input suppresses one. bin/cotal.ts loads the CLI from its build, so the mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.name: the guided form ignores --no-input
mutations.expectRed: cotal meshes add --no-input opens no prompt
mutations.cell: cotal meshes add --no-input opens no prompt
